newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Gov. declines O'Dell clemency request.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Gov. declines O'Dell clemency request.

text.p: Virginia Governor George Allen denied a last-minute request on Wednesday for clemency by convicted rapist and murderer Joseph O'Dell, who is scheduled to die by lethal injection later tonight.

"After a painstaking, careful and thorough review of all the evidence and information available to me, I see no legitimate reason that would justify my overturning the judgment of the jury and judge who heard this case," Allen said in a five-page statement.
